description: Source file implementing the ServerManagerService class for managing server applications, including logging, application initiation, and session state management within the Rialto server manager project.

classes.name: ServerManagerService
classes.description: Class responsible for managing server applications, logging, and session states within the Rialto server manager.

methods.name: ServerManagerService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with a context and preloading session servers.

methods.name: ~ServerManagerService
methods.description: Destructor logging the shutdown of the server manager.

methods.name: initiateApplication
methods.description: Starts a new application session with specified app ID, session state, and configuration.

methods.name: changeSessionServerState
methods.description: Changes the session server state for a given application ID.

methods.name: getAppConnectionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves connection information for a specified application ID.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets the logging levels for the server manager.

methods.name: registerLogHandler
methods.description: Registers a custom log handler for forwarding logs.

methods.name: forwardLog
methods.description: Forwards log messages to the registered log handler, converting levels appropriately.
